mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS request_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(usage.prompt_tokens, 0)), 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(usage.cached_prompt_tokens, 0)), 0) AS cached_prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(usage.completion_tokens, 0)), 0) AS completion_tokens, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN usage.billing_status IN (0, 2, 4) THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(usage.charged_quota_minor, 0) END ), 0) AS charged_quota_minor, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage.billing_status = 0) AS pending_request_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN usage.billing_status = 0 THEN COALESCE(detail.reserved_quota_minor, 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS pending_reserved_quota_minor FROM ai_model_api_usage usage LEFT JOIN ai_model_api_usage_detail detail ON detail.usage_id = usage.id WHERE usage.key_digest = #{keyDigest,jdbcType=BINARY} AND usage.created_at >= #{from,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} AND usage.created_at < #{to,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
